component.name: delulu
component.description: The DeluluLang compiler, runtime, and toolchain

properties.name: delulu:note
properties.value: Direct third-party dependencies of the workspace, with the versions resolved in the committed Cargo.lock. Transitive dependencies are enumerated by that lockfile, which is the authoritative and complete record; this document lists what the workspace itself declares. An SBOM that omits something linked into the binary is worse than none, because it will be trusted — so the omission is stated here rather than left to be discovered.

components.name: serde
components.description: Serialization framework — the DIR, manifests, lockfiles, and every --json envelope

components.name: serde_json
components.description: The machine surface: diagnostics, authority reports, the registry index

components.name: toml
components.description: delulu.toml manifests. Parsed as a pure function of text — no code runs at resolution time

components.name: wasmtime
components.description: The WASM engine. The containment floor for Contained plugins

components.name: wasm-encoder
components.description: WASM codegen for --target wasm (delulu-wasm declares 0.221; resolved 0.221.3). The tree also carries transitive 0.219.2/0.252.0 copies from wasmtime; this entry is the one the workspace itself declares

components.name: ed25519-dalek
components.description: Artifact and plugin signatures, and the broker's lease tokens

components.name: getrandom
components.description: OS randomness: signing seeds, registry tokens, guard owner codes

components.name: blake3
components.description: Content hashes for the lockfile and the audit chain

components.name: libloading
components.description: Foreign C library loading — outside the effect proof, gated by ForeignCall

components.name: pyo3
components.description: Embedded CPython. Optional — the Python-less build is a first-class citizen

components.name: anyhow
components.description: Error plumbing in the host tooling

components.name: libc
components.description: Platform syscalls for the isolation profiles

components.name: ml-dsa
components.description: ML-DSA / FIPS 204 post-quantum signatures (delulu-runtime, pinned =0.1.1). Unaudited by its authors; every invocation without --unstable refuses (DL1910)

components.name: ml-kem
components.description: ML-KEM / FIPS 203 key encapsulation (delulu-runtime, pinned =0.3.2). Linked but with no caller yet (D15d); listed because it is in the build
